insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and is effective as of August 31, 2026. Previously, taxes were not recalculated after a shipping address change.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their apps' tax calculation logic to ensure it aligns with this update. They should also test their apps to handle the new tax recalculation behavior. Additionally, developers should be aware that this change only affects unfulfilled orders and does not impact fulfilled orders. The orderUpdate mutation will now return the updated taxes in the response, allowing developers to handle any tax changes programmatically.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations after updating the shipping address on an unfulfilled order, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and reducing potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: This update ensures accurate tax calculations and compliance with tax regulations, which is crucial for merchants and developers. It also provides a better experience for merchants by reducing potential errors and ensuring accurate order totals.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3 and @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.1 patches improve local debugger reliability and connections.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Shopify Functions
themes.detail: New fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS, and the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field. Additionally, updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes.

themes.detail: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, and the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement for customer accounts.
